Unpaid: a nonvanishing graph-polynomial coefficient with every exponent at most 6 for every combined plane graph. No universal orientation invariant proved.
Literal K2 obstruction complete; signed orientation does not give unsigned labeling. Endpoint correction only; nontrivial lobsters remain unresolved here. DERIVATIONS.md.
